research_role: positive-only auxiliary training, development, and sealed external confirmation

source.dataset: Eye on Methane MARS sources and plumes

paper_comparator_exclusion.reason: New auxiliary labels must not expose the successor to a paper-test facility or exact paper-test acquisition.

catalog_selection.deduplicate_sample_key: exact target product plus source-centered crop
catalog_selection.group_unit: source_name with a 25 km connected-component fallback

fixed_group_split.sealed_external_use: one-time positive recall and mask IoU confirmation only after architecture and thresholds are frozen

image_contract.target_and_reference: exact tile and tile_background products named by UNEP
image_contract.sentinel2: MSI L1C target/reference using the released MARS-S2L band and normalization contract
image_contract.landsat: USGS Collection-2 Level-1 target/reference using the released MARS-S2L band and normalization contract
image_contract.crop: 4 km source-centered crop on the released MARS-S2L grid contract
image_contract.cloud_and_nodata: same observability policy used by the frozen MARS paper evaluator

promotion_gates.paper: unchanged exact MARS-S2L v3 full and test-only-site paired-bootstrap gates
promotion_gates.external: report positive recall and segmentation IoU with site-block confidence intervals; do not claim AP or false-positive rate without validated negative scenes

storage.tracked_outputs: compact protocol, acquisition audit, cohort manifest identities/counts, experiment summaries, and code only

frozen_invariants: After download but before outcome filtering, the Landsat display name was corrected from spacecraft-specific placeholders to the catalog's documented aggregate value; LC08/LC09 remain enforced from exact product IDs.

Before outcome filtering, deduplication was clarified to exact product plus source-centered crop because one full satellite tile can contain multiple distant facilities; only plume records within the same source crop are merged.
The catalog checksum is provenance, not a reason to alter selection rules after download.
No paper-test label, location, target product, or pixel mask may enter fitting.
All target/reference products must be the exact products named by UNEP.
UNEP non-detections and unlisted scenes are never treated as NO_PLUME labels.
Source groups never cross auxiliary-training, development, or sealed-external roles.
The sealed external bucket remains unread until the successor is frozen.
